descriptor: Local-first notes with folders and pins

voice.summary: Pocketpad talks like a well-kept notebook: short labels, plain verbs and no fuss. It reassures people that their words stay on their own device and that nothing is lost when they tidy up.
dos: Use two or three words for every action label
Say where things live: this folder, this device
Confirm destructive actions with an undo, not a warning
donts: Do not use cloud or sync language; notes are stored locally
Avoid productivity hype and streak counters

taglines: Notes that stay in your pocket
A tidy place for loose thoughts
Your notes, kept on your device
boilerplate: Pocketpad is a three-pane notes app with folders, pinned notes and a live-saving editor, storing everything locally so writing stays fast and private.

microcopy.success: Saved. Saved here, on this device.
microcopy.error: Could not save that note. Your text is still on screen.
microcopy.empty: No notes in this folder yet. Start one.

logo.note: An open book signals a notebook without leaning on pencil clichés, and fits a calm paper-and-ink interface.
